framework.name: TP1 trend pullback (guidance only, not a label; paper-tracked as TP1)
framework.rules: Uptrend = close > rising EMA50 or weekly EMA50 rising. Buy pullbacks to EMA20 or confirmed Hidden Bullish; trim 20% at each Getting warm/Take profit touch; exit on daily close > 3% below EMA50.
